Delhi Air Quality Worsens Amidst Pollution Concerns

Air quality in Delhi and surrounding regions has deteriorated, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) in 23 cities in Haryana exceeding 200, and Panchgaon being the most polluted. Vehicle emissions are cited as a significant contributor to the crisis, with one report suggesting they are a greater concern than stubble burning. The Supreme Court has requested action plans from Delhi and three other states. Noise pollution levels during Diwali were also reported as severe, particularly in Karol Bagh. Concerns have been raised about the impact of pollution on children's respiratory health, especially those with pre-existing conditions like asthma. In response to the poor AQI, IIT Kanpur is exploring a cloud-seeding attempt, with aircraft reportedly ready. Data gaps regarding air quality have also been addressed by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).
